thread:
jules: quick alert — atlas-v2 q4 bring-up on staging shows a reproducible hit on short multilingual translation evals (ja / zh-Hant) and an odd RTL punctuation mirror in an en->ar mixed sample. repro + tiny examples below. anyone seen tokenizer/packaging related splits like this when switching quant backends?

jules: repro command:
```
./eval_locales --model=atlas-v2 --quant=q4 --locales=ja,zh-Hant,ar \
  --dataset=short-trans-2026 --metrics=bleu,chrf --seed=2026 --batch=32
```

jules: metric snapshot (float32 => q4):
```
locale    float32_bleu  q4_bleu   float32_chrf  q4_chrf
ja        33.8          29.0      50.2          45.1
zh-Hant   29.6          25.1      46.3          41.0
ar        41.0          39.8      (N/A)         (N/A)
```

jules: failing sample (ja):
src: "\u3010\u30b3\u30f3\u30c6\u30f3\u30c4\u3011\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0\u30dd\u30b9\u30c8\u3002"
ref: \u3010\u30b3\u30f3\u30c6\u30f3\u30c4\u3011\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0\u30dd\u30b9\u30c8\u3002
q4_out: \u3010\u30b3\u30f3\u30c6\u30f3\u30c4\u3011\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0 \u30dd\u30b9\u30c8\u3002  (extra space inserted inside katakana word)

mei: sample looks like a token split introduced mid-word. i ran tokenize-diff on the model bundles tokenizer.

mei: tokenize debug:
```
float tokenize("\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0\u30dd\u30b9\u30c8") -> ["\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0\u30dd\u30b9\u30c8"]
q4 tokenize("\u30d6\u30ed\u30b0\u30dd\u30b9\u30c8")    -> ["\u30d6\u30ed","","\u30b0\u30dd\u30b9\u30c8"]
```
mei: note the empty token in the middle. detok collapses differently and scoring loses alignment.

akash: i also have a zh-Hant example where an ideographic hyphen/ZWJ combo is splitting a compound word and dropping a character on detok.

akash: zh example:
src: "\u96fb\u5b50\u30b3\u30f3\u30de\u30fc\u30b9\u30fb\u5909\u66f4\u3002"
float tokenize -> ["\u96fb\u5b50\u30b3\u30f3\u30de\u30fc\u30b9","\u30fb","\u5909\u66f4","\u3002"]
q4 tokenize    -> ["\u96fb","","\u5b50","\u30b3...", ...]

akash: that empty token / weird split pattern matches the katakana case. suspect tokenizer binary mismatch or a changed split table.

yuki: unrelated but the en->ar mixed-sentence we saw showed mirrored parentheses on q4 output: opening paren became closing (\u0028 -> \u0029) next to RTL run. probably a detok/order issue after token-level resegmentation, not bidi algorithm itself.

ci-bot: Build metadata:
- atlas-v2:float image built 2026-03-22, tokenizers@3.1.4, model-bundle hash: bb77cc
- atlas-v2:q4   image built 2026-03-21, tokenizers@3.0.9, model-bundle hash: bb77cc
(ci-bot) Note: model-bundle hash matches but runtime tokenizers version differs in images.

jules: that explains it — packaging put the same model bundle in two images but the runtime tokenizer lib differs. we need deterministic embedding of tokenizer runtime or a hard check in model loader.

mei: short-term mitigation: add a detok post-filter that collapses empty tokens and normalizes ideographic hyphen/ZWJ sequences before eval scoring. will try on canary and report. not ideal but should recover most of the delta.

akash: long-term: pin tokenizer runtime and record a tokenizer checksum in the bundle; fail deploy if runtime tokenizer != bundle checksum. also add unit tests covering katakana adjacency, ideographic-hyphen, and bidi-adjacent punctuation.

jules: i'll open GH issue with failing examples, tokenize diffs, and CI changes required. pinging infra to add a pre-deploy hook for tokenizer checksum validation. thanks all.
